17/// A decoded region bitmap with its combination operator.
18#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
19pub(crate) struct RegionBitmap {
20    /// The decoded bitmap.
21    pub(crate) bitmap: Bitmap,
22    /// How to combine this region with the page bitmap.
23    pub(crate) combination_operator: CombinationOperator,
24}
25
26/// "These operators describe how the segment's bitmap is to be combined with
27/// the page bitmap." (7.4.1.5)
28#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
29pub(crate) enum CombinationOperator {
30    /// 0 OR
31    #[default]
32    Or,
33    /// 1 AND
34    And,
35    /// 2 XOR
36    Xor,
37    /// 3 XNOR
38    Xnor,
39    /// 4 REPLACE
40    Replace,
41}
42
43// Not really a default, just used as a dummy placeholder.
44
45impl CombinationOperator {
46    pub(crate) fn from_value(value: u8) -> Result<Self> {
47        match value & 0x07 {
48            0 => Ok(Self::Or),
49            1 => Ok(Self::And),
50            2 => Ok(Self::Xor),
51            3 => Ok(Self::Xnor),
52            4 => Ok(Self::Replace),
53            _ => err!(RegionError::InvalidCombinationOperator),
54        }
55    }
56}

58/// Template used for arithmetic of generic regions.
59///
60/// - Generic regions: `GBTEMPLATE` (7.4.6.2)
61/// - Symbol dictionaries: `SDTEMPLATE` (7.4.2.1.1)
62/// - Pattern dictionaries: `HDTEMPLATE` (7.4.4.1.1)
63/// - Halftone regions: `HTEMPLATE` (7.4.5.1.1)
64/// - Gray-scale images: `GSTEMPLATE` (Annex C)
65#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
66pub(crate) enum Template {
67    /// Template 0
68    ///
69    /// Context bits: 16 (Figure 3).
70    Template0 = 0,
71    /// Template 1
72    ///
73    /// Context bits: 13 (Figure 4).
74    Template1 = 1,
75    /// Template 2
76    ///
77    /// Context bits: 10 (Figure 5).
78    Template2 = 2,
79    /// Template 3
80    ///
81    /// Context bits: 10 (Figure 6).
82    Template3 = 3,
83}
84
85impl Template {
86    pub(crate) fn from_byte(value: u8) -> Self {
87        match value & 0x03 {
88            0 => Self::Template0,
89            1 => Self::Template1,
90            2 => Self::Template2,
91            3 => Self::Template3,
92            _ => unreachable!(),
93        }
94    }
95
96    /// Number of context bits for this template (6.2.5.3).
97    pub(crate) fn context_bits(self) -> usize {
98        match self {
99            Self::Template0 => 16,
100            Self::Template1 => 13,
101            Self::Template2 | Self::Template3 => 10,
102        }
103    }
104
105    /// Number of adaptive template pixels (6.2.5.3).
106    pub(crate) fn adaptive_template_pixels(&self) -> u8 {
107        match self {
108            Self::Template0 => 4,
109            Self::Template1 | Self::Template2 | Self::Template3 => 1,
110        }
111    }
112}

114/// Parsed region segment information field (7.4.1).
115///
116/// "A region segment information field contains the following subfields, as
117/// shown in Figure 30:
118/// - Region segment bitmap width – see 7.4.1.1.
119/// - Region segment bitmap height – see 7.4.1.2.
120/// - Region segment bitmap X location – see 7.4.1.3.
121/// - Region segment bitmap Y location – see 7.4.1.4.
122/// - Region segment flags – see 7.4.1.5." (7.4.1)
123#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
124pub(crate) struct RegionSegmentInfo {
125    /// "This four-byte field gives the width in pixels of the bitmap encoded
126    /// in this segment." (7.4.1.1)
127    pub(crate) width: u32,
128    /// "This four-byte field gives the height in pixels of the bitmap encoded
129    /// in this segment." (7.4.1.2)
130    pub(crate) height: u32,
131    /// "This four-byte field gives the horizontal offset in pixels of the bitmap
132    /// encoded in this segment relative to the page bitmap." (7.4.1.3)
133    pub(crate) x_location: u32,
134    /// "This four-byte field gives the vertical offset in pixels of the bitmap
135    /// encoded in this segment relative to the page bitmap." (7.4.1.4)
136    pub(crate) y_location: u32,
137    /// "Bits 0-2: External combination operator." (7.4.1.5)
138    pub(crate) combination_operator: CombinationOperator,
139    /// "Bit 3: Colour extension flag (COLEXTFLAG). This field specifies whether
140    /// the region segment is extended to represent coloured bitmap." (7.4.1.5)
141    pub(crate) _colour_extension: bool,
142}
143
144/// Parse the region segment information field (7.4.1).
145pub(crate) fn parse_region_segment_info(reader: &mut Reader<'_>) -> Result<RegionSegmentInfo> {
146    // 7.4.1.1: Region segment bitmap width
147    let width = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
148    // 7.4.1.2: Region segment bitmap height
149    let height = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
150    // 7.4.1.3: Region segment bitmap X location
151    let x_location = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
152    // 7.4.1.: Region segment bitmap Y location
153    let y_location = reader.read_u32().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
154
155    // 7.4.1.5: Region segment flags
156    let flags = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)?;
157
158    // "Bits 0-2: External combination operator."
159    let combination_operator = CombinationOperator::from_value(flags)?;
160
161    // "Bit 3: Colour extension flag (COLEXTFLAG)."
162    let colour_extension = flags & 0x08 != 0;
163
164    // "Bits 4-7: Reserved; must be 0."
165    if flags & 0xF0 != 0 {
166        bail!(RegionError::InvalidCombinationOperator);
167    }
168
169    Ok(RegionSegmentInfo { width, height, x_location, y_location, combination_operator, _colour_extension: colour_extension })
170}

172/// Adaptive template pixel position for generic and refinement regions (6.2.5.4, Figure 7).
173#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default)]
174pub(crate) struct AdaptiveTemplatePixel {
175    pub(crate) x: i8,
176    pub(crate) y: i8,
177}
178
179/// Parse refinement adaptive template pixels (used by symbol dictionary and text region).
180///
181/// Used for:
182/// - Symbol dictionary refinement AT flags (7.4.2.1.3): SDRATX1/SDRATY1, SDRATX2/SDRATY2
183/// - Text region refinement AT flags (7.4.3.1.3): SBRATX1/SBRATY1, SBRATX2/SBRATY2
184/// - Generic refinement region AT flags (7.4.7.3): GRATX1/GRATY1, GRATX2/GRATY2
185pub(crate) fn parse_refinement_at_pixels(reader: &mut Reader<'_>) -> Result<Vec<AdaptiveTemplatePixel>> {
186    let x1 = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)? as i8;
187    let y1 = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)? as i8;
188
189    let x2 = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)? as i8;
190    let y2 = reader.read_byte().ok_or(ParseError::UnexpectedEof)? as i8;
191
192    Ok(vec![AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: x1, y: y1 }, AdaptiveTemplatePixel { x: x2, y: y2 }])
193}

195/// Template used for refinement arithmetic coding (7.4.7.2).
196///
197/// - Generic refinement regions: `GRTEMPLATE` (7.4.7.2)
198/// - Symbol dictionaries: `SDRTEMPLATE` (7.4.2.1.1)
199/// - Text regions: `SBRTEMPLATE` (7.4.3.1.1)
200#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
201pub(crate) enum RefinementTemplate {
202    /// Template 0: 13 pixels (6.3.5.3, Figure 12)
203    Template0 = 0,
204    /// Template 1: 10 pixels (6.3.5.3, Figure 13)
205    Template1 = 1,
206}
207
208impl RefinementTemplate {
209    pub(crate) fn from_byte(value: u8) -> Self {
210        if value & 0x01 == 0 { Template0 } else { Template1 }
211    }
212
213    /// Number of context bits for this template (6.3.5.3).
214    pub(crate) fn context_bits(&self) -> usize {
215        match self {
216            Self::Template0 => 13,
217            Self::Template1 => 10,
218        }
219    }
220}
